description: This file defines an enum 'LaunchdManager' with static methods to manage launchd tasks for the OpenClaw application, including starting and stopping the service via launchctl commands.

methods.name: runLaunchctl
methods.description: Private static method that executes the launchctl command with specified arguments.

methods.name: startOpenClaw
methods.description: Starts the OpenClaw service by invoking launchctl with the 'kickstart' command.

methods.name: stopOpenClaw
methods.description: Stops the OpenClaw service by invoking launchctl with the 'stop' command.
